preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner account)
Attacker must hold some xenoX tokens to demonstrate fee impact

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setBuyTaxFeePercent, setBuyLiquidityFeePercent, setBuydevFeePercent, setSellTaxFeePercent, setSellLiquidityFeePercent, and setSelldevFeePercent to set extremely high fee percentages (e.g., 99%). Then perform a token swap through PancakeSwap to extract excessive fees. The fees will accumulate in the contract and can be withdrawn via the dev address or through swapAndLiquify mechanism, ultimately increasing the attacker's BNB balance.
